notes: Answer key for the planted defects. detectable_by=script: the deterministic scripts must report it (expect lists code+ref). detectable_by=ai: only the AI review pass can find it; it is matched by location and category when the AI review is evaluated.

defects.why: 'быстро' has no threshold, so two testers can disagree. Needs a number (e.g. within 1 s) or should be dropped.
BR-1 allows 20–300 kg. Valid values 20–29.9 and 250.1–300 would be rejected. TC-DEMO-002 follows the AC, so the tests would 'pass' while breaking the business rule.

defects.quote: запись не создаётся, … сообщение …, значение остаётся …, фокус переходит …, при повторной ошибке …
defects.why: Five separate behaviours in one AC; one failure fails the whole AC and the report says nothing about which part broke. The 'repeated error → red' part also has no TC.
'понятное' is subjective. The AC should give the exact text or its required content (e.g. allowed range).
Table and class names are design, not user-observable behaviour. Renaming the class would 'break' the AC. Keep only: the entry is still in the list after reload.
Two different requirements share one ID; TC-DEMO-003 and TC-DEMO-005 both claim AC-DEMO-003, so it is impossible to tell what is covered.
How many is 'последние'? 7, 30, all? Sorted by entry date or by creation time? Tester cannot write an expected result.
7 days from what — the entry date or the moment it was created? Is day 7 inclusive? What does the user see on day 8?

defects.quote: BR-3. На одну дату — не больше одной записи.
defects.why: No AC says what happens when the user saves a second entry for the same date: error, overwrite, or ask? The developer will guess.

defects.quote: spec: TC-DEMO-004 → AC-DEMO-004; matrix: TC-DEMO-004 under AC-DEMO-002
defects.why: Spec and matrix disagree, so the coverage report is wrong for two requirements.
Claims full coverage; AC-DEMO-005 has no TC.

defects.quote: отображается в списке после перезагрузки страницы
defects.why: Two readings: 'the entry survives a page reload' (persistence) or 'the entry appears only after a reload'. Neither AC-DEMO-001 nor AC-DEMO-004 says the list updates without a reload.
defects.found_by: QA review 2026-11-02 (not planted; added to the key)

defects.why: The spec template requires edge cases, UI states, API/data model, security/performance and limitations/open questions. Without them nobody can tell whether e.g. the error states or the API were forgotten or deliberately left out.
defects.found_by: check_sections.py (added 2026-11-02 when the skill was extended to whole-spec review)
